notes: DEC NC Sixty-Third Revised Leaf No. 99, eff 2025-01-01 (blk307 source). SIX rate-class sections: p1 = (1) 'Residential Schedules RS, RE, ES, RT, RSTC, RETC' TOTAL 0.1125 c/kWh; (2) 'General Service Schedules SGS, BC, LGS, TS, S, HLF, OPT-V, PG, SGSTC' TOTAL 0.2487; (3) 'Lighting Schedules PL, OL, NL' TOTAL -1.0898; p2 = (4) 'Industrial Schedules I, HLF, OPT-V, PG' TOTAL 1.2148; (5) 'Schedule HP - General Service' Baseline 0.2487 / Incremental -0.0230; (6) 'Schedule HP - Industrial' Baseline 1.2982 / Incremental 0.0452. The residential page holds ONE residential section; the second cents/kWh section on page 1 is GENERAL SERVICE (own heading and schedule list), NOT a second residential rate period - confirms the prior suspicion. One effective date (2025-01-01) for the whole leaf; per-row dates differ (1/1/25, 7/1/24, 9/1/24, 1/15/24). PRINTED-TARIFF INCONSISTENCY: 'Schedule HP - Industrial' Baseline TOTAL is printed 1.2982 but its components (identical to the Industrial section, which totals 1.2148) sum to 1.2148; 1.2982 = 1.2148 + 0.0834, i.e. the printed total behaves as if the Nuclear PTC credit (-0.0834) were added with the wrong sign. Verified against the rendered page image: transcription is correct, the tariff's own total is wrong (checksum_ok=false is the expected outcome). Also printed as-is: HP-Industrial 'Energy Efficiency Rider' line date reads 1/1/24 while all other EE rows read 1/1/25 (probable typo in source).
